usage: build-hermes-plugin.py [-h] [--repo-root REPO_ROOT] [--out OUT]

Build the Hermes lazy-router plugin for The Agency agents. The generated
plugin exposes a small fixed tool surface to Hermes and keeps the large agent
roster in an on-disk JSON data file. That avoids using skills.external_dirs,
which advertises every Agency agent in Hermes' initial skill catalog.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --repo-root REPO_ROOT
  --out OUT             Output directory, default integrations/hermes
